metadata.title: Wak Gominda | Garo Recipe
metadata.description:
This is a more authentic version of a previous recipe that I shared on pork and pumpkin. Traditional A'chick (Garo) cooking doesn't involve use of oil and most of the dishes involves usage of Lye locally known as Kalchi. 

This juicy as delicious pork dish is an all time favorite of Garos is suitable for any occasion.
